programs.title: Masti
programs.desc: Three henpecked friends tired of their respective marriage decide to spice up their lives by indulging in an extramarital affair. But things go downhill very quickly when they become the prime suspects in a deadly murder case.

programs.title: Bhagam Bhag
programs.desc: Bunty and Babla are two wannabe actors and want to play the lead in their theatre's play. Soon, their inappropriate behaviour causes the female lead to quit and they get tasked to finding another which hilariously lands them in a convoluted trouble.

programs.title: The Legend Of Bhagat Singh
programs.desc: During the British Raj, upon witnessing the atrocities of the British, Bhagat Singh grows up to be a fierce freedom fighter. His publicised ideas of revolution bring him to as much popularity as Mahatma Gandhi amongst Indians.
